propositions: Complex bug fixes declaring non-test file_impact escalate from light-advisory tier to full blocking rubric, enforced at both precheck and route_criteria seams; small fixes retain light advisory tier unchanged.
Gerrit DET criterion blocks oversized bug fixes (>150 non-test lines) lacking certified or code-drifted-acceptable attestation, with teaching message directing author to write fix plan and re-review.

Attestation verification reads cross-host via opcert_from_record + trusted_env_keyring(record principal) + verify_opcert machinery, never via own-env plan_review_status; accepts certified/stale-code/stale-head, flags all other verdicts except unavailable/error which fail open.

Non-test line classification rule: diff lines matching tests/** or conftest.py are excluded; all other paths (src, scripts, workflows, docs) count as non-test; single shared 150-line threshold constant in rebar used by both B1 blast-radius escalation and B2 gerrit criterion.

Backtest validates classifier and threshold against 113 historical bug-fix commits: exactly 13 flagged (>150 non-test lines) matching hand-adjudicated substantive fixes; zero false positives on mechanical changes (rename/move/format/generated churn).
